Following example suggests how to configure CAN-FD related parameters such as baudrate and buffer size.

## Example: Configure all CAN 2.0 related parameters in easyConfig and use BSW APIs for communication. {#example-configure-all-can-2.0-related-parameters-in-easyconfig-and-use-bsw-apis-for-communication. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

### Step 1: {#step-1 .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Configure a CAN channel for CAN 2.0 during pre-compile time (configuration in easyConfig).

in Communication \--\> Select CAN

### Step 2: {#step-2 .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Configure CAN baudrate for the selected CAN channel.

After selecting the CAN Channel, under settings(CAN 2.0/CAN-FD) choose CAN 2.0 and then configure the desired baudrate.
